rules.name: recon-dup-12-stored-sp-vs-live
rules.sql: SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.settlement_date, h.asset_class, h.invenio_product_code, h.product_name, h.exchange_name, h.lot_mult1::double precision AS lot_mult1, h.curr_mult1::double precision AS curr_mult1, h.mult_factor::double precision AS mult_factor, h.nc_factor::double precision AS nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

WITH cmv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult FROM opera.curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), ccmv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, invenio_product_code, value_date FROM opera.cloned_curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), mxv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, invenio_product_code, value_date, murex_nc_factor FROM opera.murex_nc_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), sp AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, s.business_unit, s.security_id, pm1.asset_class, pm1.invenio_product_code, pm1.product_name, pm1.exchange_name, pm1.lot_mult AS lot_mult1, cm1.curr_mult AS curr_mult1, pm1.murex_mult AS mult_factor, mx.murex_nc_factor AS nc_factor FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN cmv cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN ccmv cm2 ON cm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm2.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND cm2.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_product_master_table pm2 ON pm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN mxv mx ON mx.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND mx.business_unit = s.business_unit AND mx.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND mx.value_date = v.value_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC') ) SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.settlement_date, sp.asset_class, sp.invenio_product_code, sp.product_name, sp.exchange_name, sp.lot_mult1, sp.curr_mult1, sp.mult_factor, sp.nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

expect.reason: shape C BUs have published settle rows
the stored product fields, multipliers and nc_factor equal what sp returns, so view v6 can read them
